INTERACTIVE DATA VISUALIZATION · POLITICAL ECONOMY

Where Are the Rural Voices?

Mapping rural-born representation in EU national parliaments · Interactive R Shiny project · 2024

Research question

Are rural-born citizens becoming less visible in national politics? This descriptive research project maps the share of parliamentarians born in rural areas across six European countries—Germany, France, Spain, Ireland, Czech Republic and Austria—from 1999 to 2019. The analysis examines birthplace-based representation rather than the current residence or political priorities of elected officials.

Data and interactive analysis

The R Shiny application combines parliamentary birthplace classifications, country-level percentages and party-level distributions. Users can select countries, inspect rural/city/town-suburb birthplace counts by party, hover to view rural-born shares, and move a time slider to explore changes across legislative years.

R Shinysf / leaflet1999–2019Six countriesInteractive mapping

Selected descriptive findings

The mapped data suggest declining shares of rural-born parliamentarians across several countries. Ireland stands out: its rural-born share was approximately 50% in 1999 and 37.69% in 2019, remaining the highest among the six countries in this analysis. Other countries often show substantially lower shares in later years.

These are descriptive patterns, not estimates of causal effects or of the probability that a rural-born person enters parliament. Changes in population composition, migration and electoral institutions may contribute to the observed trends.

Explore the interactive R Shiny map

Use the embedded application to select a country and legislative year and inspect the map and associated plots.

Interpretation and next questions

The project raises questions about political opportunity and representation: do rural origins shape pathways into national office, and how do electoral systems and urbanization affect these patterns? Answering them requires additional data and causal research beyond this visualization.
